content.name: computer-vision-inference-optimization
content.description: Use when profiling, deploying, or optimizing computer-vision inference pipelines for latency, throughput, memory, cost, FPS, or device constraints. Trigger for decode/preprocess/model/postprocess/index stages, tiling, batching, export and runtime compatibility, precision and quantization, streaming video, frame timing, and capacity planning. Not for model training or generic service and SRE ownership.
